tagline: Optical innovation designed to transform the visual experience.
introRest: so you can see the world with greater clarity, beauty, and confidence.
paragraphs: Novar began with a clear goal: to understand how we really see and design lenses that adapt to the way we naturally perceive the world.
Years of research and development led to exclusive technologies such as Psicoptix Technology™ and CDT Technology™, which now define a new way to experience optics.
